accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= cap
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  ex accepted(0, [1]) == 0
  -- nondet.channel is not supported by this toolchain, so the bounded
  -- channel is modelled by a counter: a send is accepted while n < cap.
  var n = 0
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    if n >= cap
      break
    n += 1
  n
